author: Codex
authorization_literal: Dale, revisa la estabilidad de B08 y el deterioro de B09 en nuevo negocio. Registra la siguiente prueba solo en 2023, conserva B00, deja los resultados en el foro y mantén 2024 cerrado.

objective.calibration: Training-only Tweedie-optimal scalar per business/line/fold for B10/B11; in-sample, explicitly distinct from prior B00-level anchor.
objective.primary_development_metric: Pooled unweighted total-unit D2 Tweedie 1.5 on all 50094 OOF rows of 2023; global null is arithmetic mean of observed T0; do not average line D2 scores
objective.positivity: Fail on nonfinite or nonpositive rate/prediction; no silent clipping or removal

observation_link: Each development fold k uses frozen exclude_foldk/e_cost_mix_1.0, fitted only on other 2023 groups; all three model families use exactly the same link and T0 response.
features: Exact availability_contract.blocks[line].all whitelist, no annual weather or optional profiles; metadata excluded. Numeric and categorical training transforms are fitted inside the training rows only.

level_rule.scope: One scalar per parent, line, held-out fold and x_new_business in {0,1}; use only outer-training rows.
level_rule.factor: mu=e*r_parent; q=sum_fit(Y/sqrt(mu))/sum_fit(sqrt(mu)) within each business segment; r_new=q*r_parent.
level_rule.objective: Exact positive scalar minimizer of total-unit Tweedie p1.5 for the frozen parent shape within the training segment; no weights or clipping.
level_rule.parameters: Two recipes, 30 factors each, no grid, smoothing, OOF calibration or new native estimator fits for B10/B11.
level_rule.anchor: Explicitly replaces the B00 training aggregate anchor for the new variants; B00 and B08/B09 remain unchanged comparators.
limits: In-sample calibration, not independent or inner-cross-fitted calibration.
Does not force training/validation A/E=1; Tweedie objective is not observed aggregate balancing.
Strictly positive fit segment loss required; zero numerator fails the recipe, no fallback.
Preserves ordering within fold/line/business only; sparse claims may destabilize factors.

development_uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile, conditional exploratory diagnostic; NOT the 2024 Bonferroni confirmation interval
development_uncertainty.pairs: All 66 pairs of twelve candidate recipes, common 2000 exploratory draws. Stress is separate and not a selection alternative.

diagnostics.observation_sensitivity: At fixed fitted OOF rates, recompute predictions and response for reserve075, reserve125, late_cost05, late_cost10 using saved scoped links. This is an observation-only diagnostic, not a refit or the complete confirmation safeguards.
diagnostics.no_selection: Keep B00 and every alternative; no promotion, retirement, equivalence or final confirmation roster here.

readout_before_testing.technical: Exact previous OOF, all guards/replay, train-only q derivative and no 2024/test rows.
readout_before_testing.level: Report overall, line, fold, business and line x business D2/A/E. Compare new variants to their own parents as well as B00; adverse results retained.
readout_before_testing.stability: Report fold delta signs, top31 removal of each candidate and fixed B08/B09 group lists. Stress compares unchanged validation rows after full training-group deletion; no claim of temporal stability.
readout_before_testing.interpretation: Any negative segment/unstable scale or adverse stress remains visible; no threshold-based promotion in this development. B00 retained regardless.

technical_acceptance: Only 2023 fit/predict/score, no held-out row in q or stress fitting
Exactly 60 positive scalar factors and 30 adapters for B10/B11
15 stress GLM fits and 15 stress constants with own preprocessing and convergence
Deleted groups selected exclusively from training T0, disjoint from validation; complete components removed
C0 fixed in stress, limitation disclosed
Saved-model replay and independent scalar/metric/removal checks
B00 through B09 OOF exact, original code/recipes immutable
No 2024 ledger, scores, test predictions, promotion or final roster
scope: 2023 only, saved five group folds, exact F0 and C0. No cap/filter in primary fits or scoring, no recipe tuning, no future-year materialization.
resources: Local CPU two threads; 60 scalar factors, 30 segment adapters; separate 15 GLMs and 15 constants for stress. Expected minutes, no remote compute.
search_disclosure: Fourth adaptive 2023 batch after ten recipes. Two candidate recipes and one fixed stress preregistered before factors/refits; intervals unadjusted for search/66 comparisons. No promotion.
hypothesis: Training-only business-specific level factors may address level imbalance, but sparse positive claims and in-sample parent fits may worsen generalization. Independently assess conditional B08 refitting sensitivity to severe training groups.

stability_stress.deletion: For each outer fold, pool the saved outer-training rows of all lines, aggregate T0 by customer-address group; rank descending T0, then ascending string group_id; remove ceil(.001 * number_of_training_groups) complete groups in every line.
stability_stress.refit: Relearn F0 preprocessing and B03 GLM (alpha10 buildings, alpha1 motor/contents), B00 constant and B08 level anchor on remaining rows. Fixed B08 mixing .5, original solver parameters, no tuning.
stability_stress.observation_link: Frozen outer-fold C0, excludes validation groups but still reflects deleted training groups. Conditional price/preprocessing stress, NOT end-to-end refit of reporting or a full jackknife.
stability_stress.evaluation: Unchanged outer-validation rows. Save S08 and S00 separately from candidate OOF; report S08 vs original B08, original B00 and stress S00, folds/segments and paired rate changes. No deletion from validation or main fits.
stability_stress.fits: 15 GLMs and 15 closed-form constants, no tree fits, no seed changes.
